### Open Mic

![Open Mic](space/open-mic-3.jpg)

Ballina open mic all are welcome music/poetry/comedy/storytelling whatever floats your boat. Sign up will be at 9.00pm. Both right and lefthand guitars will be provided. Hosted by Seán Gorman and Joe Clarke.

### Event Details
- **Date:** Saturday 23rd August 2025
- **Time:** 9pm
- **Location:** TheNCF Collective, 5 Pearse Street, Upstairs. 
- **Admission:** Free
